name: Yaotsu (Japan)
description: A orange field charged at the centre with the Yaotsu town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Yaotsu, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 November 1963.

features.role: Yaotsu town emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised character
